LanguageData.LP_Thralled.label: dominated
LanguageData.LP_Thralled.description: This person's mind is held tight by a mind flayer, fighting for the colony like a puppet. Once the dominating mind flayer dies or is downed, the domination ends.
LanguageData.LP_ThrallAwakening.label: domination broken
LanguageData.LP_ThrallAwakening.description: The mind flayer's domination suddenly snapped; this person's mind can't come back yet and they collapsed. They'll come to after a while.
